Developed in our R&D laboratory, our custom formulations extend bath life while optimizing operating costs and ensuring full compliance with international quality standards.

Service detail faq intro: Frequently asked questions about our industrial coating chemicals, bath analyses, and technical support processes:
FAQ Question 1: Do you provide bath setup and periodic analysis support?
FAQ Answer 1: Yes, our expert technical team performs on-site bath setup and keeps your bath parameters under continuous control through regular sample analyses.
FAQ Question 2: How can we transition from our current plating chemicals to Teknokimya products?
FAQ Answer 2: Samples taken from your existing bath are analyzed in our R&D laboratory to prepare a compatible transition plan and dosing recipe without halting your production.
FAQ Question 3: Are Technical Data Sheets (TDS) and Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) available for your products?
FAQ Answer 3: All our chemical products are delivered with internationally compliant Technical Data Sheets (TDS), Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and batch quality control certificates.
